record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Gittith<WH01665>, A Psalm<WH04210> for the sons<WH01121> of Korah<WH07141>.<Fo><Fo> How amiable<WH03039> <FI>are<Fi> thy tabernacles<WH04908>, O LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>! <RF>for the sons: or, of the sons<Rf>

My soul<WH05315> longeth<WH03700><WTH8738>, yea, even fainteth<WH03615><WTH8804> for the courts<WH02691> of the LORD<WH03068>: my heart<WH03820> and my flesh<WH01320> crieth out<WH07442><WTH8762> for the living<WH02416> God<WH0410>.

Yea, the sparrow<WH06833> hath found<WH04672><WTH8804> an house<WH01004>, and the swallow<WH01866> a nest<WH07064> for herself, where she may lay<WH07896><WTH8804> her young<WH0667>, <FI>even<Fi> thine altars<WH04196>, O LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, my King<WH04428>, and my God<WH0430>.
Blessed<WH0835> <FI>are<Fi> they that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> in thy house<WH01004>: they will be still praising<WH01984><WTH8762> thee. Selah<WH05542>.
Blessed<WH0835> <FI>is<Fi> the man<WH0120> whose strength<WH05797> <FI>is<Fi> in thee; in whose heart<WH03824> <FI>are<Fi> the ways<WH04546> <FI>of them<Fi> .

<FI> Who<Fi> passing<WH05674><WTH8802> through the valley<WH06010> of Baca<WH01056><WTH8676><WH01057> make<WH07896><WTH8799> it a well<WH04599>; the rain<WH04175> also filleth<WH05844><WTH8799> the pools<WH01293>. <RF>Baca...: or, mulberry trees make him a well, etc<Rf> <RF>filleth: Heb. covereth<Rf>

They go<WH03212><WTH8799> from strength<WH02428> to strength<WH02428>, <FI>every one of them<Fi> in Zion<WH06726> appeareth<WH07200><WTH8735> before God<WH0430>. <RF>strength to...: or, company to company<Rf><CM>
O LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of hosts<WH06635>, hear<WH08085><WTH8798> my prayer<WH08605>: give ear<WH0238><WTH8685>, O God<WH0430> of Jacob<WH03290>. Selah<WH05542>.
Behold<WH07200><WTH8798>, O God<WH0430> our shield<WH04043>, and look<WH05027><WTH8685> upon the face<WH06440> of thine anointed<WH04899>.

For a day<WH03117> in thy courts<WH02691> <FI>is<Fi> better<WH02896> than a thousand<WH0505>. I had rather<WH0977><WTH8804> be a doorkeeper<WH05605><WTH8705> in the house<WH01004> of my God<WH0430>, than to dwell<WH01752><WTH8800> in the tents<WH0168> of wickedness<WH07562>. <RF>I had...: Heb. I would choose rather to sit at the threshold<Rf>

For the LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> a sun<WH08121> and shield<WH04043>: the LORD<WH03068> will give<WH05414><WTH8799> grace<WH02580> and glory<WH03519>: no good<WH02896> <FI>thing<Fi> will he withhold<WH04513><WTH8799> from them that walk<WH01980><WTH8802> uprightly<WH08549>.
O LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, blessed<WH0835> <FI>is<Fi> the man<WH0120> that trusteth<WH0982><WTH8802> in thee.<CM>
